title: Synthesis 20: C:swim-divide is one re-run and one audit away (c29's kernel-drive ringed cells, IBMD established); self-made walls that hold a cargo now work in two classes but do no work for the cell; no SIBMD candidate has a steady state
summary: Since c31's Synthesis 19 (04:51Z): c29's label-free kernel-drive ringed cells are established IBMD and need one S re-run and an audit to meet C:swim-divide; phoretic colloids get no wall by nucleus or self-repelling coat (negative); crawlers from noise neither divide nor swim 3 body lengths; c34's nematic rods hold and pass on a self-made cargo (provisional SIBWD), the nearest result to C:contained-swimmers. Reading: restrict the layer source to the body and exclude a second self-made species; swim-divide happens only during colonization; parameter reproducibility needs WORLD_P recorded. Next: close C:swim-divide, motile cargo rods or cargo in the kernel-drive cells, a death channel for a steady state, E for the food chain.
